direction: Higher is better for all four raw scores and normalized ranks.
deduplication: Exact original raw target strings within each source; retain all route origins.
normalization: Within-source ascending zero-based average ranks divided by m-1; singleton 0.5.
total: Arithmetic mean of the four normalized ranks.
margin: Frozen standard all-pool k=4 ratio, not leave-origin-out.
qwen: Frozen yes-logit minus no-logit, not a calibrated correctness probability.
raw_score_precision: Full Python float round-trip precision; no paper-table rounding.
